envelope.description: the answer as the command line prints it with --output json; null with an error

format.description: the envelope format; a change that breaks a consumer increments it

detail.description: summary or full: how much of each result the envelope holds

at.description: the time each device's snapshot is read at or before; empty for the latest

device.description: the firewall the path starts on; empty when the source places the start

flow.description: the flow as simulated: endpoints resolved, ports as numbers

rib.description: whether each hop lists the routing table's other routes to the destination

router.description: the start's logical router; empty when it has one

input.description: the question as answered, with the flow as simulated

answer.description: one line that says what the result found, as the text output prints it

code.description: the input's code: input.port, input.protocol, input.url, input.application, input.from-zone or input.to-zone

input.description: the input to give in a second call

text.description: what to give and which rules it decides

needs.description: present when the result is held back: the inputs a second call can give to change it; empty when none helps

level.description: exact, overmatch (may hold more than the device matches), inferred (from data the device may not use) or undermatch (may miss matches)

reasons.description: why the result is weaker than exact

fidelity.description: how certain the result is: exact, overmatch, inferred or undermatch, with the reasons; never report undermatch or inferred as a firm answer

end.description: where and why the path ended, in words

end_code.description: the reason code of the path end

hidden.description: firewalls the path crossed that the inventory does not hold

route.description: the route taken: prefix via next hop or interface; empty when none matched

hops.description: the firewalls the path crossed, in order

results.description: the answers; empty when no target could be read

answer.description: the count line of the text output

found.description: results over every target, the omitted ones included; for snapshot diff, single changes

with.description: targets with a result; for snapshot diff, devices with a change

without.description: targets read without a result; for snapshot diff, devices compared without a change

omitted.description: results the limit left out; for snapshot diff, single changes; 0 when every result is shown

summary.description: search, lookup and snapshot diff only: the count of results over the targets read

holes.description: devices or snapshots the answer could not read; each one makes the answer incomplete

vsys.description: the vsys; empty for the device as a whole

value.description: the value that was not resolved

unresolved.description: values the answer could not resolve; each one can hide matches

notes.description: facts that qualify the answer without making it incomplete, such as a stale snapshot

oneOf.description: the simulate routing answer, detail summary
